## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present` passes
- [ ] `npm test --workspaces --if-present` passes
- [ ] For DB changes: a Prisma migration is included
- [ ] For wire/contract changes: updated the Zod schema in `@gamepulse/shared`
- [ ] Updated docs / README where relevant
- [ ] No secrets, API keys, or personal data in the diff
